Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The proteomics analysis involved three distinct affinity-based approaches: GFP-Trap pulldowns of histone mutants, native-PAGE band excision of NASP complexes, and APEX2-mediated proximity biotinylation (BioID) followed by streptavidin purification. All these methods target purified protein complexes rather than whole cell lysates.
